d: Short, messy jet black hair with jagged bangs falls over a mature, young adult face featuring narrow, deep brown eyes and a small scar on the left cheek. The lean, athletic build is dressed in a black leather motorcycle jacket adorned with colorful graffiti-style patches, worn over a black undershirt and a black neck scarf, paired with teal-blue cargo trousers and black leather shoes. Signature accessories include a red and silver motorcycle helmet held in the hand, a large sword strapped to the back, a smaller blade at the hip, and black fingerless gloves.
